'''''Philonotis''''' is a genus of [[moss]]es belonging to the family [[Bartramiaceae]].<ref name="GBIF">{{cite web |title=Philonotis Brid. |url=https://www.gbif.org/species/2676069 |website=www.gbif.org |access-date=12 February 2021 |language=en}}</ref>

The genus was first described by [[Samuel Elisée Bridel-Brideri]].<ref name="GBIF" />

The genus has a [[cosmopolitan distribution]].<ref name="GBIF" />
